theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (J : ℝ → Euclid P → ℝ) (q : Euclid P → ℝ) (B C t₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet E → μ E ≠ ∞ → 0 < t₀ → AEStronglyMeasurable q (μ.restrict E) → (∀ x ∈ E, |q x| ≤ B) → (∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μ E ≤ ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (J t x) ∂μ) → (∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → ∀ x ∈ E, J t x ≤ 1 + t ^ 2 / 2 * q x + C * |t| ^ 3) → 0 ≤ ∫ x in E, q x ∂μ
